picks.title: Colourful sunrise likely today 6:56am
picks.body: 35% odds of colour. Best bets: Cottonwood Canyon State Park (International Dark Sky Park), Wishram scenic overlook (Celilo Falls view), Deschutes River mouth (Deschutes River SRA). Horizon toward the sun is 100% open.
why: 41% chance of a colourful sunrise sky (HRRR: mid/high cloud 20–80%, low cloud under 40%)
also checks for a low cloud deck between you and the sun
path toward the rising sun 100% open (25–300 km)
picks.lens: 16-50 wide, foreground first; bracket for the bright horizon
